subject: Architecture
title: Architecture Without Architects
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Architecture Without Architects.

hook.text: Could AI eventually design entire buildings with no human architect involved? Some researchers think so.

buildup.text: AI already handles floor plans, structural analysis, energy modeling, and material selection independently.

discovery.text: A fully automated pipeline from client brief to construction drawings is technically possible today — in theory.

twist.text: But architecture isn't just function — it's culture, emotion, and meaning. Algorithms don't understand beauty.

climax.text: The future architect may be a curator — choosing, refining, and adding soul to AI-generated proposals.

punchline.text: AI can build the house. Only a human can make it feel like home.

quiz.question: What role might future architects play alongside AI?
options: Writing code to program construction robots
Curating and adding meaning to AI-generated designs
